title: UCP core objects (v2026-08-25)
caption: The profile document holds the ucp metadata and a top-level keys array. A checkout carries payment instruments that point at a handler instance by handler_id and hold an opaque credential (token, PAN or network token). With the AP2 extension a checkout also has an ap2 object. A completed checkout points to an order, which records fulfillment and adjustments. Field names from the v2026-08-25 JSON Schemas; lists trimmed.
alt: Class diagram. Profile has ucp metadata and keys. Ucp metadata has version, services, capabilities, payment_handlers, supported_versions and status, and links to service bindings (version, transport, endpoint, schema), capability entries (version, spec, schema, extends, config) and payment handlers (id, version, available_instruments, config). Checkout has id, status, line_items, currency, totals, links, messages, actions, expires_at, continue_url, payment and order. Checkout has payment instruments (id, handler_id, type, credential, display); each instrument refers to a payment handler by handler_id and contains a credential with type and token. Checkout has an optional ap2 object with merchant_authorization and checkout_mandate. Checkout refers to an order with id, checkout_id, permalink_url, line_items, fulfillment and adjustments; adjustments have id, type, status and occurred_at.
